notes.title: Dreamshard demo for limited time
notes.notes:
As you know Steam Game Festival is already on, so we decided that it will be a perfect time to share with you a small piece of the game. The free demo will be available for the whole week.

In the meantime, I am working very hard to improve the game as much as possible before the Early Access release. By the way the game is not feature complete yet it is just a  simple demo. If you want to Closed Beta or simply say Hello, You are welcomed on Dreamshard [b][url=https://discord.com/invite/BRYC2G8]Discord[/url][/b]
